### UI QA Report: MTQΣ Institutional Dashboard (Light Theme)

**1) Is the whole page light?**
Yes. The page utilizes a consistent "paper" aesthetic with an off-white/cream background (`#f9f9f7` or similar), a subtle grid pattern, and white card containers. The overall luminance is high throughout.

**2) Any leftover dark panels, glows, or unreadable text?**
*   **Dark Elements:** The only intentional dark elements are the **MTQΣ logo** (top left and footer) and the **sidebar active state highlight** ("Dashboard"). These are deep teal/black, which fits the "ink text" requirement.
*   **Glows:** There are no neon glows or heavy drop shadows. The styling is flat and clean.
*   **Unreadable Text:** All primary text is dark gray/black on light backgrounds. Readability is high.

**3) Do charts/tables render cleanly with readable colors?**
*   **Charts:** There are no traditional line/bar charts visible in this view. However, the **Progress Bar** in the "Implementation Status" section renders cleanly with a distinct Teal fill against a light gray track.
*   **Tables:** The "All 13 gates" list renders as a clean, structured list/table. The hierarchy (Gate ID, Title, Description, Status Badge) is clear. The status badges use appropriate contrast (e.g., outlined gray for "Pending", solid/filled for others).

**4) List of Defects & Locations**

| Severity | Location | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Medium** | **Main Content Area (Below "Investor Verification")** | **Missing Content / Empty State:** Large sections labeled "$DEPLOYMENTS", "$2-$8 LIVE SNAPSHOT", "V1.2 RECONCILIATION", etc., appear to be completely empty headers with no data or placeholder cards inside them. This looks like a loading failure or incomplete layout. |
| **Low** | **Top Navigation Bar (Status Indicators)** | **Color Consistency:** The "Production: NO" indicator uses red text, which is good. However, "Risk: NORMAL" uses a very faint green that might fail accessibility contrast checks against the white background. |
| **Low** | **Sidebar (Bottom)** | **Button Styling:** The "NOT PRODUCTION-AUTHORIZED" button at the bottom of the sidebar has a very light red background with red text. While readable, it feels slightly washed out compared to the high-contrast "Ink" style used elsewhere. |
| **Info** | **Footer (Copyright)** | **Text Size:** The copyright text "© 2026 MTQΣ Protocol..." is extremely small and light gray. It is legible but sits on the edge of readability for users with visual impairments. |

**5) Verdict**
**PASS (with reservations regarding content loading)**

The UI successfully implements the **Light/Fresh/Paper** design system. The color palette (Teal accent, Ink text, White cards) is applied consistently. The layout is clean and professional. 

**Critical Action Item:** The development team needs to investigate why the lower half of the dashboard (Deployments, Snapshots, Reconciliation) is rendering as empty space. If this is intended to be a "scroll-empty" state, it needs a visual placeholder (illustration or "No Data" message). If it is a bug, components are failing to mount.
